invariants.expression: result != null && result instanceof HoodieSavepointMetadata && result.getSavepoint() != null && result.getSavepoint().equals(instantToSavepoint)
invariants.rationale: The method returns a HoodieSavepointMetadata object corresponding to the savepoint instantToSavepoint.
A non-empty user string is expected for recording the savepoint.
Comment is either null or a non-empty string.
Context must be non-null for the savepoint action executor to function.
The savepoint instant identifier is expected to be a non-empty string.
